pages.text: Olly is real. He's my dog, and he fights cows.$(br2)Name any tamed wolf (or Doggy Talents dog) $(l)Olly$() and he becomes Olly:$(li)$(l)+20 health$()$(li)$(l)+4 bite damage$()$(li)$(l)15% faster$()$(li)$(l)Olly-sized$(): a bit smaller than a regular wolf, just like the real one

$(l)He fights cows.$() When Olly sees a cow nearby he gets fired up: speed and strength, plus a little angry particle so you know he means it.$(br2)Every cow Olly takes down drops $(l)Olly's Trophy$(), a glowing bone. Collect one for the $(o)He Fights Cows$() challenge.$(br2)Rename him and he goes back to being a regular dog. Don't do that to him.

pages.title: Olly's Trophy
pages.text: A shiny bone. Only drops from cows that Olly personally handled.
